packageRules.description: Python dev/docs tooling: refresh the uv-compiled lock only WITHIN the declared range. update-lockfile never widens a `<X` ceiling, so deliberate caps (e.g. pytest-asyncio <1.4 for #806) are honored automatically and a ceiling raise stays a manual edit to requirements-*.txt. Auto-merge — the required CI checks are the gate; nothing from pip ships in the plugin.
npm + GitHub Actions: auto-merge minor/patch/digest; majors are left for human review.
